1.text: “Nuko rero Yobu, ndakwinginze wumve ibyo mvuga,Kandi utegere amatwi amagambo yanjye yose.

2.text: Dore ubu mbumbuye umunwa wanjye,Ururimi rwanjye ruvugiye mu kanwa kanjye.

3.text: Amagambo yanjye agaragaze gutungana k'umutima wanjye,Kandi ibyo nzi ururimi rwanjye rurabivuga ntafite uburyarya.

4.text: Mwuka w'Imana ni we wandemye,Kandi guhumeka kw'Ishoborabyose ni ko kwambeshejeho.

5.text: “Nubishobora unsubize,Amagambo yawe uyatunganirize imbere yanjye,Uhagarare ushikamye.

6.text: Dore mpwanye nawe imbere y'Imana,Nanjye nabumbwe mu gitaka.

7.text: Umva igitinyiro cyanjye ntikizagutinyisha,Kandi ukuboko kwanjye ntikuzakuremerera.

8.text: “Ni ukuri wavuze numva,Kandi numvise amagambo y'ijwi ryawe uti

9.text: ‘Ndaboneye nta gicumuro mfite,Nta rubanza rundiho kandi nta kibi kindimo.

10.text: Ariko rero Inshakaho impamvu,Indebaho nk'umwanzi wayo.

11.text: Ibirenge byanjye ibishyira mu mbago,Yitegereza inzira zanjye zose.’

12.text: “Reka ngusubize, muri ibyo ntukiranutse,Kuko Imana isumba abantu.

13.text: Ni iki gituma uyigisha impaka,Kuko itagomba gusobanura ibyayo?

14.text: Imana ivuga rimwe,Ndetse kabiri nubwo umuntu atabyitaho.

15.text: Mu nzozi mu iyerekwa rya nijoro,Igihe abantu bashyizweyo,Basinziriye ku mariri yabo.

16.text: Ni ho yumvisha amatwi y'abantu,Igashyira ikimenyetso ku byo ibigisha,

17.text: Kugira ngo igamburuze umuntu mu migambi ye,Ngo imaremo umuntu ubwibone bwe buhishwe.

18.text: Ubugingo bwe iburinda rwa rwobo,No kubaho kwe ikakurinda kurimburwa n'inkota.

19.text: Maze kandi ahanwa n'umubabaro ari ku buriri bwe,Ahora aribwa mu magufwa ntahweme,

20.text: Bigatuma ubugingo bwe buhurwa ibyokurya,N'umutima we ukanga ibiryoshye.

21.text: Umubiri we urananuka ntube ukigaragara,N'amagufwa ye atagaragaraga akānama.

22.text: Ni ukuri ubugingo bwe bwegera ikuzimu,No kubaho kwe kwerekeye ku barimbuzi.

23.text: “Niba abonekerwa na marayika w'umurengezi,Ni inyamibwa imwe mu gihumbi,Wamenyesha umuntu inzira akwiriye kunyuramo.

24.text: Ni ho Imana yamubabarira iti‘Murokore kugira ngo atamanuka akajya muri rwa rwobo,Nabonye Umucunguzi.’

25.text: Umubiri we uzagwa itoto birushe uw'umwana,Asubire mu busore bwe.

26.text: Asaba Imana na yo ikamugirira ibambe,Bituma ayireba mu maso anezerewe,Kandi igarurira umuntu gukiranuka kwe.

27.text: Aririmbira imbere y'abantu ati‘Naracumuye nkagoreka ibyari bigororotse,Ariko nta cyo byamariye.

28.text: Nyamara yancunguriye ubugingo ngo butajya muri rwa rwobo,Kandi kubaho kwanjye kuzareba umucyo.’

29.text: “Dore ibyo byose bikorwa n'Imana,Igenza ityo umuntu kabiri ndetse gatatu,

30.text: Kugira ngo igarure ubugingo bwe ngo butajya ikuzimu,Abone kumurikirwa n'umucyo w'abazima.

31.text: “Huguka cyane Yobu we, untegere amatwi,Uceceke nanjye mvuge.

32.text: Niba ufite icyo kuvuga unsubize,Vuga kuko nifuza kugutsindishiriza.

33.text: Niba ari nta cyo untegere amatwi,Ceceka nanjye nkwigishe ubwenge.”
